for Identity
Provides security solution set-up guidance to identify, detect, and
investigate advanced threats that might compromise your on-
premises user identities. These include detecting suspicious user
activities and malicious insider actions directed at your
organization. You'll create a Defender for Identity instance,
connect to your organization's on-premises Active Directory, and
then set up sensors, alerts, notifications, and configure your
unique portal preferences.
